title: Loading data overlay remains after navigating away from theme details
description: The 'Loading data...' overlay persists and obstructs the UI even after the user navigates back to the main Themes screen.
steps: Tap on the 'Themes' icon in the bottom navigation bar.
Tap on the three-dot menu icon for the 'Fifthy Groups' theme.
Tap the back arrow at the top left of the screen.
Observe the 'Loading data...' overlay is still visible and obstructing the UI of the Themes screen.
actual: The 'Loading data...' overlay remains on the screen after navigating back to the Themes list, preventing interaction with the UI.
expected: The 'Loading data...' overlay should disappear upon successfully navigating back to the Themes screen, allowing normal interaction.
